diagram.documentation:
The full gUFO taxonomy of class inheritance, as imported by CCM, showing all classes (including unions and superclass intersections) with constraints.

The full type hierarchy of named gUFO classes plus the «Union» and «Superclass Intersection» classes and the stereotyped dependencies («Disjoint With» and «Complement Of»), created by the CCM importer.

 

Due to an issue with the importer, some of the required UML disjointness and completeness constraints and corresponding generalization classes were not created automatically by the importer (only disjointness dependencies were created). The missing disjointness and completeness constraints have been added manually and are distinguished y being named generalization sets and, on this diagram only, by purple text. Unless otherwise noted, the disjointness and completeness constraints are in accordance with the imported restrictions from gufo.ttl and, where those are not present, as per A First-Order Logic Formalization of the Unified Foundational Ontology [Porelo et al., 2021] (hereinafter UFO Formalization).

 

The diagram is arranged to correspond as closely as possible to the Taxonomy diagram in the UFO Formalization Diagrams.vpp model. For the formal representation of majority elements on this diagram, see the UFO Formalization [Porelo et al., 2021]. gUFO adds some elements compared to the UFO Formalization, but also lacks some elements defined in the UFO Formalization. Most of the concepts are common to both however (sometimes with different names for the same concept).

 

For non-taxonomic relationships, see gUFO Metamodel - Non-taxonomic relations excl. constraints (Disjoint With, Complement Of )
